spans.text: Well, your plan's been put into action and you're in danger. What will you do now?

units.rawText: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.
units.displayText: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.

spans.text: The Entropics are currently gathered at 11 o'clock, which is where the Rossum Sector is.

units.rawText: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.
units.displayText: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.

spans.text: We'll head in the 2 o'clock direction. It'll be safer there for the time being.

units.rawText: What are you trying to do?
units.displayText: What are you trying to do?

spans.text: What are you trying to do?

units.rawText: You'll know once we get there.
units.displayText: You'll know once we get there.

spans.text: You'll know once we get there.

units.rawText: We only have a half a vanguard team and they have wounded with them.
units.displayText: We only have a half a vanguard team and they have wounded with them.

spans.text: We only have a half a vanguard team and they have wounded with them.

units.rawText: I hope you're not going to take too big of a risk.
units.displayText: I hope you're not going to take too big of a risk.

spans.text: I hope you're not going to take too big of a risk.

units.rawText: Croque and the others will fix Hannah's big gun soon. We only need to hold out until then.
units.displayText: Croque and the others will fix Hannah's big gun soon. We only need to hold out until then.

spans.text: Croque and the others will fix Hannah's big gun soon. We only need to hold out until then.

units.rawText: ...Indeed. Got it.
units.displayText: ...Indeed. Got it.

spans.text: ...Indeed. Got it.

units.rawText: I need a few people to maintain the barrier. Take the rest and clear a path.
units.displayText: I need a few people to maintain the barrier. Take the rest and clear a path.

spans.text: I need a few people to maintain the barrier. Take the rest and clear a path.

units.rawText: Yeah, I'm counting on you!
units.displayText: Yeah, I'm counting on you!

spans.text: Yeah, I'm counting on you!

units.rawText: Dammit, there's no end to these Entropics!
units.displayText: Dammit, there's no end to these Entropics!

spans.text: Dammit, there's no end to these Entropics!

units.rawText: Entropics swamp us like waves on an ocean. Sol cuts apart an Entropic that's charging at her and frowns after looking back at the wounded agents without realizing it.
units.displayText: Entropics swamp us like waves on an ocean. Sol cuts apart an Entropic that's charging at her and frowns after looking back at the wounded agents without realizing it.

spans.text: Entropics swamp us like waves on an ocean. Sol cuts apart an Entropic that's charging at her and frowns after looking back at the wounded agents without realizing it.

units.rawText: These guys are too hard to handle! We can't keep this up and the casualties in the team can't sustain any longer, Prof!
units.displayText: These guys are too hard to handle! We can't keep this up and the casualties in the team can't sustain any longer, Prof!

spans.text: These guys are too hard to handle! We can't keep this up and the casualties in the team can't sustain any longer, Prof!

units.rawText: Tsk, all we need is to fight off this wave...
units.displayText: Tsk, all we need is to fight off this wave...

spans.text: Tsk, all we need is to fight off this wave...

units.rawText: Actually, I have a plan that we could try.
units.displayText: Actually, I have a plan that we could try.

spans.text: Actually, I have a plan that we could try.

units.rawText: Antonina? Weren't you in the rear just now...
units.displayText: Antonina? Weren't you in the rear just now...

spans.text: Antonina? Weren't you in the rear just now...

units.rawText: Sorry, Professor.
units.displayText: Sorry, Professor.

spans.text: Sorry, Professor.

units.rawText: Before I can react, a sudden force shoves me on the back.
units.displayText: Before I can react, a sudden force shoves me on the back.

spans.text: Before I can react, a sudden force shoves me on the back.

units.rawText: I feel myself fly through the air, but at the same time, a pale green current forms a barrier around me. Sol and Antonina's voices suddenly sound like they're coming from far away.
units.displayText: I feel myself fly through the air, but at the same time, a pale green current forms a barrier around me. Sol and Antonina's voices suddenly sound like they're coming from far away.

spans.text: I feel myself fly through the air, but at the same time, a pale green current forms a barrier around me. Sol and Antonina's voices suddenly sound like they're coming from far away.

units.rawText: Anna?! What are you doing?
units.displayText: Anna?! What are you doing?

spans.text: Anna?! What are you doing?

units.rawText: Relax, the Prof won't die. Just watch.
units.displayText: Relax, the Prof won't die. Just watch.

spans.text: Relax, the Prof won't die. Just watch.

units.rawText: Miss Croque! The front row of Entropics are changing direction!
units.displayText: Miss Croque! The front row of Entropics are changing direction!

spans.text: Miss Croque! The front row of Entropics are changing direction!

units.rawText: Oh, so you're brave enough to space out in the middle of a battle, aren't you? Charging complete! Dirac!
units.displayText: Oh, so you're brave enough to space out in the middle of a battle, aren't you? Charging complete! Dirac!

spans.text: Oh, so you're brave enough to space out in the middle of a battle, aren't you? Charging complete! Dirac!

units.rawText: <size=40>FIRE—</size>
units.displayText: FIRE—

spans.text: FIRE—

units.rawText: Soon, my visibly disheveled form is escorted back into the front row of the formation by the backline agent fighters. Antonina welcomes me back with a distinct look of schadenfreude in her face.
units.displayText: Soon, my visibly disheveled form is escorted back into the front row of the formation by the backline agent fighters. Antonina welcomes me back with a distinct look of schadenfreude in her face.

spans.text: Soon, my visibly disheveled form is escorted back into the front row of the formation by the backline agent fighters. Antonina welcomes me back with a distinct look of schadenfreude in her face.

units.rawText: Are you alright, Professor?
units.displayText: Are you alright, Professor?

spans.text: Are you alright, Professor?

units.rawText: Fortunately, you had the fighters ready to receive me, which was why I didn't manage to die.
units.displayText: Fortunately, you had the fighters ready to receive me, which was why I didn't manage to die.

spans.text: Fortunately, you had the fighters ready to receive me, which was why I didn't manage to die.

units.rawText: That does sound like a bit of a shame.
units.displayText: That does sound like a bit of a shame.

spans.text: That does sound like a bit of a shame.

units.rawText: You're not mad at me for doing that of my own volition, are you Professor~
units.displayText: You're not mad at me for doing that of my own volition, are you Professor~

spans.text: You're not mad at me for doing that of my own volition, are you Professor~

units.rawText: ...I now have a keen appreciation for just how annoying those airborne Entropics that I handed to you are.
units.displayText: ...I now have a keen appreciation for just how annoying those airborne Entropics that I handed to you are.

spans.text: ...I now have a keen appreciation for just how annoying those airborne Entropics that I handed to you are.

units.rawText: Professor, we managed to weather this wave of Entropics. We'll be resting and recovering at the designated point from earlier.
units.displayText: Professor, we managed to weather this wave of Entropics. We'll be resting and recovering at the designated point from earlier.

spans.text: Professor, we managed to weather this wave of Entropics. We'll be resting and recovering at the designated point from earlier.

units.rawText: How about our losses?
units.displayText: How about our losses?

spans.text: How about our losses?

units.rawText: No new casualties. Thanks to those Entropics hesitating, my Dirac led everyone to wipe them out!
units.displayText: No new casualties. Thanks to those Entropics hesitating, my Dirac led everyone to wipe them out!

spans.text: No new casualties. Thanks to those Entropics hesitating, my Dirac led everyone to wipe them out!

units.rawText: Organize a medical team to treat our casualties and keep an eye out around us.
units.displayText: Organize a medical team to treat our casualties and keep an eye out around us.

spans.text: Organize a medical team to treat our casualties and keep an eye out around us.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: Still, what was Anna thinking just now...
units.displayText: Still, what was Anna thinking just now...

spans.text: Still, what was Anna thinking just now...

units.rawText: Just watching the movements of the Entropics after we split up would have been enough, tossing me out there was just for revenge, right...
units.displayText: Just watching the movements of the Entropics after we split up would have been enough, tossing me out there was just for revenge, right...

spans.text: Just watching the movements of the Entropics after we split up would have been enough, tossing me out there was just for revenge, right...

units.rawText: Prepare for battle!
units.displayText: Prepare for battle!

spans.text: Prepare for battle!

units.rawText: Antonina sighs, and then begins typing rapidly on her keyboard.
units.displayText: Antonina sighs, and then begins typing rapidly on her keyboard.

spans.text: Antonina sighs, and then begins typing rapidly on her keyboard.

units.rawText: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector.
units.displayText: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector.

spans.text: On the outskirts of the Rossum Sector.
